links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid level) and PEMAT-P understandability of chatbot cataract surgery patient education responses
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kincaid level was 8.02 for Google Bard versus 5.75 for ChatGPT-4 (p<0.001). PEMAT-P understandability was 85.8% for ChatGPT-4 versus 80.9% for Bard (p<0.001). Actionability was about 42.5% vs 44.2% (p=0.344).
links.quote: Google Bard had a higher mean overall Flesch-Kincaid Level (8.02) compared with ChatGPT-4 (5.75) (p<0.001), also noted across all three domains.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT-4 and Google Bard for generating patient education materials evaluated by clinicians and readability tools; does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
